title: 동사 만들기: 내가 했어요? 됐어요? 시켰어요?
objective: You can use ten noun-based verbs in short sentences and tell when to use -하다 (someone does it), -되다 (it happens), or -시키다 (someone makes another person or thing do or become something).
summary: Learn ten intermediate verbs built from a noun plus -하다, -되다, or -시키다, and practice choosing the right ending.

task.title: Choose and fill in
task.line: Pick the right ending (-하다, -되다, or -시키다) for each sentence, then write the verb in the form shown.

words.meaning: to postpone, to put off (an event or plan to a later date)
words.example: 비가 와서 축제를 다음 주로 연기했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: It rained, so we put off the festival until next week.

words.meaning: to change (a set time, plan, or setting)
words.exampleMeaning: I'd like to change my flight's departure time.

words.meaning: to solve, to sort out (a problem)
words.exampleMeaning: If it's hard to sort out on your own, let me know anytime.

words.meaning: to install (an app, machine, or device)
words.exampleMeaning: I installed the bank app on my phone.
The river near the factory has become badly polluted.

words.meaning: to be completed, to be finished (a building or piece of work)
words.example: 새 도서관은 내년 봄에 완성될 예정이에요.
words.exampleMeaning: The new library is scheduled to be finished next spring.

words.meaning: to develop (an idea or skill) further, to build on
words.example: 이 아이디어를 조금 더 발전시켜 봅시다.
words.exampleMeaning: Let's develop this idea a little further.
Next time, I won't let the fans down.

words.meaning: to reassure, to put (someone's) mind at ease
words.exampleMeaning: The doctor reassured the patient, saying it was nothing serious.

words.meaning: to have (someone) admitted to the hospital
words.exampleMeaning: The fever wouldn't go down, so we had our child admitted to the hospital.

exercises: Choose the correct form: ① 공사가 끝나서 새 다리가 (완성했어요 / 완성됐어요). ② 비가 많이 와서 학교가 운동회를 (연기했어요 / 연기됐어요).
Choose the correct form: ① 약속에 늦게 가서 친구를 (실망했어요 / 실망시켰어요). ② 쓰레기 때문에 바닷물이 (오염됐어요 / 오염시켰어요).
Fill in the blank with 설치하다, 변경하다, or 해결하다 in the past tense (-했어요): ① 기사님이 오셔서 새 세탁기를 ____. ② 은행 앱에서 비밀번호를 ____. ③ 이웃과 대화해서 소음 문제를 ____.
Fill in the blank with 안심시키다, 입원시키다, or 발전시키다 in the past tense (-었어요): ① 엄마가 무서워하는 아이를 꼭 안아 주면서 ____. ② 폐렴이 심해서 의사가 할아버지를 바로 ____. ③ 그 사장님은 작은 빵집을 큰 회사로 ____.
Complete the sentence in Korean using 변경 + the right ending. The airline changed your flight time, not you. Tell your friend: 항공사 사정으로 비행기 시간이 ____.
answers: ① 설치했어요 (설치하셨어요 / 설치해 주셨어요) ② 변경했어요 ③ 해결했어요
① 안심시켰어요 ② 입원시켰어요 ③ 발전시켰어요 (발전시키셨어요)
